title: Consolidate duplicated SCHNORR48_ED25519_ALG constant
description: SCHNORR48_ED25519_ALG = -65537 is defined independently in python/src/lichen/crypto/capability_announcements.py and python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py:37. Both old and new crypto/__init__.py import it from capability_announcements, so behavior is unchanged, but the duplicated literal risks drift. Consolidate to a single definition (e.g. export from one module, import in the other) and re-run uv run --directory python pytest tests/crypto/. Flagged by reviewer edge-cases pass during worker6-feqj; out of scope there.
